text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0825 CDT.

CANOLA - C$3.00 to C$5.00 a tonne lower on weekend rain in U.S. soybean growing regions as well as ideal growing weather on the Prairies. August was seen down C$3.70 to C$350, November was expected to fall C$4.70 to C$340 at the open. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -6.77 Friday from -6.48 Thursday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3728, and rose to 84.31 yen and 1.3067 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$3.00 to C$4.00 down on spill over pressure.
PEAS - US$1.00 to US$2.00 a tonne lower on CBOT soymeal.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$2.00 to C$3.00 a tonne down on weekend rain in U.S. corn growing regions as well as ideal growing weather on the Prairies.
FEED WHEAT - C$2.00 to C$3.00 down on CBOT corn and wheat calls based on rain in the U.S.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
